name: Juggernaut
fantasy: The wrecking ball. Burns hotter with every hit, chains you in, and finishes it.

card.loop: Deal damage to fill Rage; full, you're Enraged: more damage, faster dashes and cooldowns.
card.dash: Two charges of a dash attack the way you face; its tip hits twice as hard.
card.passive: Damage fills Rage; full = Enraged (damage, dash and ability haste). Knocks heal you.
card.rmb: Tap: a wound-up slam (+50% to the wounded; rank 3: its sweet spot crashes and heals). Hold: a lunge. Air: a slam down.
card.e: Chain a foe (blighted) or a wall; press E again to pull yourself to it. Smash during the pull to spin.

weapons.greatsword: Quick slashes, double at the tip; hold to charge a Searing Wave.

passive.name: Rage
passive.desc: Damage you deal fills Rage (a Searing Wave fills it three times as fast); it cools after 3s out of a fight. Full, you're Enraged for 6s: +15% damage, +12% dash recharge and +20% cooldown speed, with the red shell and the hunter swelling. Knocking a hunter heals you 20% of their health (killing a monster, 20% of its).

dash.name: Rampage
dash.desc: A 4.4m dash attack the way you face (2 charges): 7 to foes along it; the tip at its end hits twice as hard, 14 and a big knock (stun 0.8 into a wall). A knock gives a charge back.

variants.tap: Finishing Slam: a 0.5s wind-up you aim freely (a warning shows over you), then a 3.2m cone: 26 and push 6; foes under 35% take +50%. Landing its sweet spot (the far tip, dead ahead) is a SWEET SPOT payoff; at rank 3 it also brings a 3m crash down on the foe (24, push 7, heals you 60% of the damage it deals; rests 12s, and a knock on anyone it hit within 2s makes it ready at once).
variants.hold: Lunge: charge 0.3 -> full at 0.9s, then a 3 -> 7m dash attack into the first foe: 14 -> 22. Strike nothing and the cooldown doubles.
variants.air: Meteor Drop: slam straight down, a 2.6m burst: 18 and slow 40% for 1.5s; the centre (1.2m) takes +50% and is stunned 0.8.
variants.during_e: With the Warchain: tap while it pulls you for a Cinder Spin (2.6m, 18, blights 4s); hold while it pulls you, or hold and then pull, for a Haul Slam where you arrive (2.8m, 16 -> 30, stun 0.25 -> 0.6); hold while it's attached and let go for a Chain Lunge along it (x1.25 and a short stun).

e.name: Warchain
e.desc: Throw a chain 10m: it hooks the first foe (8 damage, blighted while tethered: healing barely takes) or bites a wall, for 4s. Press E again to pull yourself to it. The cooldown starts when you pull or the chain breaks (a stun breaks it); you can't throw it while rooted or grounded.

rank3.sec: +20% damage on every Smash; its sweet spot also crashes and heals you
rank3.kin: hooking a foe refunds 33% of the cooldown

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: cooldown 3s -> 2.4s, damage +30%; +20% damage on every Smash, and its sweet spot also crashes (24 in 3m) and heals you 60% of the damage it deals; a knock resets the crash.
rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown 13s -> 10.4s, damage +30%; hooking a foe refunds 33% of the cooldown.

tells.half: red heat glowing through the pauldrons as Rage fills, steam from half
tells.full: Enraged: a red shell, the hunter swells, a roar within 25m; a red warning over the head while a Smash winds up
